fields.body_md:
## At a glance

The University of Sheffield teaches its master's courses on one main campus in Sheffield. This page covers three one-year courses: MSc Computer Science, MSc Data Science and the MBA.

The most important number is tuition. For 2027-28 entry, overseas tuition for MSc Computer Science is **£34,550 a year**. There is no application fee, and the **£7,000** scholarship in the section below may lower your fee.

| | MSc Computer Science | MSc Data Science |
|---|---|---|
| Length | **1 year**, full-time | **1 year**, full-time |
| Start | September 2027 | September 2027 |
| Overseas tuition (2027-28) | **£34,550** a year | **£36,055** a year |
| Application fee | **None** | **None** |
| Degree needed | 2:1 in a non-computing subject | 2:1 in any subject |
| English test (IELTS) | **6.5** overall, **6** in each part | **6.5** overall, **6** in each part |
| Deadline for September 2027 | **Friday 3 September 2027**, 17:00 British Summer Time | Same |

## What it really costs

Tuition is the biggest cost. Sheffield's course pages list these fees for overseas students:

- MSc Computer Science: **£34,550** a year
- MSc Data Science: **£36,055** a year

The Computer Science and Data Science pages say the university has a fixed fee guarantee in place for overseas postgraduate taught students. For the MBA fee, see the [MBA course page](https://sheffield.ac.uk/postgraduate/taught/courses/2027/mba-master-business-administration-mba).

**Deposit.** After you accept an unconditional offer (an offer with no conditions left to meet), the university normally asks you to pay a deposit on your tuition fee. A deposit is an advance payment towards your tuition. Your offer letter gives the amount and the date.

**Living money for the visa.** For the UK student visa, you must show that you can pay for your living costs. Sheffield is outside London, so the amount is **£1,171 a month** for up to **9 months**. The money must have been available for 28 days in a row.

**CAS.** A Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies (CAS) is issued by your course provider once you are accepted. You need it for your visa application.

**Visa fee and health surcharge.** The student visa application fee from outside the UK is **£558**. The Immigration Health Surcharge (IHS) is charged for students at **£776 for each year of your visa**.

### Worked first-year cost: MSc Computer Science

This is an example, not a budget. It uses full-rate tuition and the living money for 9 months.

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Tuition, MSc Computer Science (2027-28) | £34,550 |
| Living money: £1,171 × 9 months | £10,539 |
| Visa application fee | £558 |
| Immigration Health Surcharge, for your visa | £776 or more |
| **Total** | **at least £46,423** |

Your visa lasts longer than your course, so you usually pay for more than one year. A 16-month visa costs £1,164.

The sum with one year of surcharge is £34,550 + £10,539 + £558 + £776 = £46,423, so the total is at least that figure. If the £7,000 scholarship applies, tuition falls to £27,550 (£34,550 − £7,000), and the total becomes at least £39,423 (£27,550 + £10,539 + £558 + £776).

Read the rules in our [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide). To compare total costs across UK universities, use the [UK total cost breakdown](/study-abroad/study-in/uk/uk-total-cost-breakdown).

## Ways to reduce the cost

**International Postgraduate Scholarship 2027.** This is a **£7,000** tuition fee reduction for students from selected countries, and India is on the list. You do not apply for it separately. You must:

- be full-time, self-funded, with overseas fee status
- be a permanent resident of, or have lived in, India for the last three years
- accept your offer by 4pm UK time on Tuesday 6 July 2027

**Sheffield MBA Scholarship Scheme.** This gives **50%** of the MBA tuition fee, awarded on a competitive basis. All MBA offer holders are considered, so you do not apply separately. It is not for sponsored students and cannot be combined with other University scholarships. Your offer letter gives the deposit deadline.

**Alumni discount.** If you already hold a Sheffield degree, you can get up to **£2,500** off tuition. This is not a general discount for all students.

**Only one award.** The £7,000 scholarship cannot be combined with any other University scholarship or discount, unless the University says so. If you qualify for more than one, the higher award takes precedence.

## Getting in

A 2:1 is an upper second-class honours degree, and a 2.2 is a lower second-class honours degree.

- **MSc Computer Science** asks for a 2:1 honours degree in a non-computing subject. It is a conversion course for people from other subjects, and no coding is needed.
- **MSc Data Science** asks for a 2:1 honours degree in any subject.
- **MBA** asks for a 2.2 honours degree, plus at least three years of full-time postgraduate work experience.

For Indian degrees, Sheffield's India page gives these equivalents:

| UK grade | Percentage on an Indian degree |
|---|---|
| First class honours | 65% |
| 2:1 | 60% |
| 2:2 | 55% |

**English.** IELTS is an English language test. All three courses ask for **IELTS 6.5** overall, with **6** in each part. For the visa, you need English at CEFR level B2 for degree study. CEFR is a standard scale for language levels.

## Deadlines

| Item | Date |
|---|---|
| September 2027 applications, all three courses | Friday 3 September 2027, 17:00 British Summer Time |
| Last date to apply if you need a student visa | Thursday 26 August 2027 |
| Accept an International Postgraduate Scholarship offer | Tuesday 6 July 2027, 4pm UK time |

Apply early, because visa timing matters. You can apply for a student visa up to 6 months before your course starts. gov.uk says a decision usually takes 3 weeks when you apply from outside the UK.

Two other checks can take time:

- **ATAS** (Academic Technology Approval Scheme) is a certificate some courses need. If your course needs one, gov.uk says it takes at least 30 working days (6 weeks) to process. Indian nationals are not on the list of exempt nationalities, so check whether your course needs it. You must have it before you start the course.
- **TB test:** India is on the list of countries where you may need a tuberculosis (TB) test. The test must be done at a clinic approved by the Home Office.

## The courses covered here

- [MSc Computer Science](https://sheffield.ac.uk/postgraduate/taught/courses/2027/computer-science-msc): one year, full-time. Aimed at graduates of non-computing subjects who want to move into computing.
- [MSc Data Science](https://sheffield.ac.uk/postgraduate/taught/courses/2027/data-science-msc): one year full-time. A two-year part-time option is also listed.
- [MBA](https://sheffield.ac.uk/postgraduate/taught/courses/2027/mba-master-business-administration-mba): one year, full-time. Entry requires postgraduate work experience.

## Where you'll live

Sheffield's courses are taught at the main campus on Western Bank in Sheffield. The MBA is taught on the Sheffield campus too.

The university's rents page lists these postgraduate rates for 2026/27:

| Contract | Range |
|---|---|
| Weekly rent | £151.41 to £240.38 a week |
| 42 weeks | £6,359.22 to £9,562.73 a year |
| 51 weeks | £7,939.68 to £12,259.39 (Laddow Studios) |

These are 2026/27 rates, not 2027/28 rates. Check the rents page again before you plan your budget.

## Who it's a good fit for

**A strong choice if:**

- you have a 2:1 in a non-computing subject and want a one-year route into computing
- you have a 2:1 in any subject and want a one-year data science master's
- you have at least three years of full-time postgraduate work experience and want to be considered for the 50% MBA scholarship
- you can show £1,171 a month for 9 months, and pay the £558 visa fee and the health surcharge at £776 for each year of your visa

**Think carefully if:**

- your degree is a 2:2. The MBA accepts a 2.2, but MSc Computer Science and MSc Data Science need a 2:1
- you cannot reach IELTS 6.5 with 6 in each part
- you need a visa and would apply after Thursday 26 August 2027
- you plan to use the alumni discount with the £7,000 scholarship, because the two cannot be combined

## Sources

faq_json.q: How much is a master's at the University of Sheffield for Indian students?
faq_json.a: For 2027-28 entry, overseas tuition is £34,550 a year for MSc Computer Science and £36,055 a year for MSc Data Science. Both courses last one year, full-time.

faq_json.q: Does the University of Sheffield charge an application fee?
faq_json.a: No. The university says there is no application fee for postgraduate taught master's programmes.

faq_json.q: What is the Sheffield deadline for September 2027?
faq_json.a: The deadline is Friday 3 September 2027 at 17:00 British Summer Time. If you need a student visa, the last date to apply is Thursday 26 August 2027.

faq_json.q: Do I need to apply separately for the £7,000 Sheffield scholarship?
faq_json.a: No. The International Postgraduate Scholarship 2027 is not a separate application. You must accept your offer by 4pm UK time on Tuesday 6 July 2027.

faq_json.q: What IELTS score does Sheffield need?
faq_json.a: All three courses ask for IELTS 6.5 overall, with at least 6 in each part.

faq_json.q: What percentage do I need from India to get into Sheffield?
faq_json.a: Sheffield's India page gives 60% for a UK 2:1 and 55% for a 2:2. MSc Computer Science needs a 2:1 in a non-computing subject, and the MBA needs a 2.2 plus at least three years of full-time postgraduate work experience.
